proposed_relationship_schema.validation: Resolve canonical ownership before writes: this version supports page-local trigger/dialog references only. Reject a new page-local reference inside a shared definition and any component-owned instance edit requiring an unsupported override model; never detach or change instance schema implicitly. Existing saved references remain inspectable and preserved, even when new authoring is restricted. Explicit Insert local modal at page root creates both local roots outside the component under current page permissions; it is not an automatic fallback. Trigger and overlay exist on same page; target has dialog role and belongs to no unrelated unresolved relationship; title is within target. Trigger cannot target itself/ancestor cycle. Close controls belong to nearest explicitly owned dialog. Validate both roots/placement and current permissions before atomic command.
proposed_relationship_schema.native_output: Resolve overlay/title engine refs to valid unique native HTML IDs, preserving existing explicit ids. Otherwise use deterministic collision-free bk-dialog-/bk-dialog-title- ids. Derive trigger aria-controls/aria-haspopup=dialog and dialog aria-labelledby. New trigger/close button type=button. Runtime controls open state, focus, aria visibility and background inertness; editor reveal never writes display override or open attribute.
proposed_relationship_schema.migration: Existing trigger and overlay stay unrelated until explicit Link existing dialog selection with ID-based preview and Apply/Cancel. Do not auto-pair by order, proximity or matching class. Link/label/close-control repair is one reversible command and never deletes extra overlays or moves siblings silently.
proposed_relationship_schema.reference_lifecycle: Duplicate modal clones both roots and remaps target/title/internal IDs; plain Duplicate trigger keeps same explicit dialog ref and states that shared target. Delete trigger only preserves dialog. Explicit Delete dialog and linked triggers removes the named dialog and every listed referencing trigger atomically after confirmation. Generic overlay deletion preserves referencing triggers and their now-unresolved reference as Missing dialog for explicit repair; it never silently deletes triggers or retargets them. Undo restores original roots/order/refs.
proposed_relationship_schema.compatibility_gate: Reserved key/schema validation, serializer/sanitizer, server and export, clone/remap/delete reference index, compound transaction rollback and shared visitor runtime must ship together. Existing plain button/overlay generic editing remains safe until integration passes.
